config_fixes.fix: Extended theme.colors / borderRadius / fontFamily with shadcn CSS-variable tokens; added tailwindcss-animate plugin. Sprint-scaffold left an empty extend{} block which caused `border-border` and friends to fail compilation.

Replaced Tailwind v4 imports (@import 'tw-animate-css'; @import 'shadcn/tailwind.css') with v3 directives (@tailwind base/components/utilities) — the project is on tailwindcss 3.4 but sprint-scaffold emitted v4 syntax.
Renamed `setupFilesAfterEach` → `setupFilesAfterEnv` — typo in sprint-scaffold output that blocked tsc.

integration_points.rule: Sonnet may ONLY rewrite this single file during /ases-dev to swap mock-backed implementations for live axios calls via @/lib/api/client.apiClient. After all functions point at the real backend, Sonnet must DELETE frontend/src/lib/mocks.ts. No other frontend/src/** file may be touched.
